general.title: General Settings
general.language_note: Select the web UI language. Auto-detect uses your browser language (Korean or English fallback).
general.mac_multiplier: MAC Table Refresh Multiplier (x polling cycles)
general.mac_multiplier_note: e.g., if set to 5, the MAC table is fetched every 5 dashboard refreshes to reduce switch load.
general.grid_columns_note: Select how many nodes are displayed side-by-side on large screens.
general.ports_wrap_note: If a node has more ports than this threshold, the port graphic bar will wrap into multiple rows (useful for OVS switches with high port counts). Set to 0 to disable wrapping.
general.max_retries_note: Number of times to retry failed HTTP requests to switches. Set to 0 to disable retries (only 1 attempt is made; highly recommended to prevent lag if switches return 404 or have pages disabled).
general.ignored_macs_note: Specify MAC address patterns to completely exclude from the dashboard (clients, tables, maps). Support wildcards (e.g. FA:CE:*).

scanner_settings.title: Subnet Discovery & Port Scanner Settings
scanner_settings.desc: Configure active IP and TCP port scanning for local host discovery.
scanner_settings.enable_discovery_note: If enabled, the dashboard performs active ARP discovery on the specified subnet.
scanner_settings.enable_port_scan_note: If enabled, the scanner will check for open TCP ports on discovered active hosts.
scanner_settings.ports_range: TCP Ports to Scan (comma-separated or ranges)
scanner_settings.purge_hours_note: Delete connection status history logs older than this threshold. Set to 0 to disable purging.
scanner_settings.host_threads_note: Number of hosts to scan for open ports in parallel.
scanner_settings.port_threads: Port Scan Concurrency (Parallel Ports per Host)
scanner_settings.port_threads_note: Number of TCP ports to scan in parallel per individual host.
scanner_settings.timeout_ms_note: Timeout in milliseconds for TCP port connection attempts (default: 500 ms).

columns_settings.title: Column Visibility Settings
columns_settings.desc: Select which columns are visible in the node port tables on the dashboard.

infra.title: Infrastructure Devices
infra.desc: Define key network infrastructure nodes (e.g., Router/WiFi, Access Points, Repeaters). These MAC addresses are used to correctly root the network map and group client devices.

unmanaged.title: Unmanaged Switches
unmanaged.desc: Define unmanaged switches connected to a specific managed switch port. All devices learned on that parent port will be grouped under this unmanaged switch.

telemetry.desc_line3: Telemetry costs you nothing, but it helps me improve the project.

intro.title: Dashboard REST API Documentation
intro.desc: A reference guide to the HTTP endpoints built into the Switch Dashboard. All programmatic access runs through the local Flask server layer on port 8080.

endpoints.switches_desc: Retrieves a full, live status report of all managed switches. This includes system-level parameters (Uptime, Firmware, MAC) and individual port configuration metrics.
endpoints.transceiver_desc: Scrapes physical optical transceiver diagnostic metrics for the switch target at the given IP. Returns standard SFP specs alongside real-time DDMI sensors.
endpoints.transceiver_param_ip: The IP address of the target switch.
endpoints.refresh_mac_desc: Triggers an on-demand scraper thread to log into the target switch, paginate the physical MAC Forwarding table, and return a clean array of resolved bridge entries.
endpoints.refresh_mac_param_ip: The IP address of the target switch.
endpoints.speeds_desc: Retrieves instantaneous delta speed rates (traffic rate in bytes per second and packets per second) for all switches and ports since the previous scrape interval.
endpoints.history_desc: Retrieves historical data arrays for populating bandwidth charts. Ideal for mapping out transmission graphs over time.
endpoints.notes_desc_html: Appends a persistent description or note to a specific switch interface. Comments are stored on the server's local disk inside notes.json.
endpoints.notes_param_val_html: Text content of the note. Pass an empty string "" to delete notes.
endpoints.get_settings_desc: Retrieves global dashboard settings currently stored in the backend.
endpoints.post_settings_desc: Updates global settings in the dashboard environment, immediately adjusting background cycles.
endpoints.post_settings_param_refresh_html: Polling interval in seconds. Minimum value is 5.
endpoints.reset_desc: Purges temporary memory caching logs and charts, forcing a re-alignment of base traffic stats.
endpoints.backup_trigger_desc: Logs into the switch at the given IP address, triggers an on-demand download of the binary configuration file from the switch CGI interface, and saves it in the server's local file archive.
endpoints.backup_trigger_param_ip: The IP address of the target switch.
endpoints.reboot_trigger_desc: Triggers an on-demand reboot of the target switch. The device will perform a soft reset immediately, which will temporarily disrupt connectivity on that switch.
endpoints.reboot_trigger_param_ip: The IP address of the target switch.
endpoints.backups_list_desc: Scans the server backup directory and returns a sorted list of all archived configuration files including switch IP, timestamp, human-readable file size, and exact filename metadata.
endpoints.backup_download_desc: Downloads a specific archived configuration backup file from the server's local storage. This endpoint includes directory traversal protection to block unauthorized path accesses.
endpoints.backup_delete_desc: Permanently purges a specific configuration backup file from the server storage disk. Includes strict path verification to prevent directory traversal exploits.
endpoints.backup_delete_param_filename: The target backup filename to delete.
endpoints.update_oui_desc_html: Triggers an on-demand download of the official IEEE OUI registration databases (oui.txt and oui36.txt) to resolve MAC addresses to manufacturers. Requires internet connection to IEEE servers. Note that IEEE limits queries to one download per day.
endpoints.scanner_hosts_desc: Retrieves a list of all client devices detected by the background network discovery scanner, including IP address, MAC address, manufacturer vendor, switch port mapping, first/last seen timestamps, and known status.
endpoints.scanner_known_desc: Toggles the "Known Device" flag for a scanned host identified by its MAC address (or IP address fallback).
endpoints.scanner_known_param_mac: Target client's MAC address (or IP address).
endpoints.scanner_known_param_known_html: Set to 1 for known, or 0 for unknown.
endpoints.scanner_update_desc: Modifies the custom hostname or descriptive note for a scanned client device in the configurations.
endpoints.scanner_update_param_mac: Target client's MAC address (or IP address).
endpoints.scanner_update_param_field_html: Target field to edit. Must be either "hostname" or "note".
endpoints.scanner_update_param_value: The new text value. Note that hostname mappings are updated accordingly.
endpoints.scanner_delete_desc: Permanently removes a dynamically scanned host from the active dashboard database. If the host is mapped to a switch port, its scanner active state is disabled.
endpoints.scanner_delete_param_mac: Target client's MAC address (or IP address).
endpoints.scanner_history_list_desc: Retrieves all network status transitions (online/offline transitions) grouped by host, extracted from the SQLite connection history database.
endpoints.scanner_history_delete_desc: Permanently purges connection history logs for a specific host from the SQLite database.
endpoints.scanner_history_delete_param_ip: The IP address (or MAC address) of the client.
endpoints.scanner_history_clear_desc: Wipes out the entire connection timeline transition log database for all hosts. This action is irreversible.
endpoints.topology_desc: Generates node adjacency list and port connection links for managed switches and resolved client devices, feeding the interactive network map.
endpoints.switch_image_desc: Dynamically retrieves the physical SVG/PNG image rendering depicting switch port links, speeds, and activity for the device at the given IP.
endpoints.switch_image_param_ip: The IP address of the switch.
endpoints.clients_update_desc: Updates host descriptors, custom categories, or static configuration settings for a client entry mapped to a switch port.
endpoints.clients_delete_desc: Deletes a client record binding (by MAC address) from the active configuration registry.
endpoints.templates_list_desc: Returns a list of device-specific scraper settings templates stored in the templates directory.
endpoints.logs_list_desc: Reads the active backend system logs and returns the tail output of the execution thread.
endpoints.logs_level_desc: Updates backend logger verbosity levels dynamically without restarting the application thread.
endpoints.logs_clear_desc: Wipes the contents of the central execution log file stored on backend disk storage.
endpoints.logs_download_desc: Downloads the complete text log file from the server storage.
